pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a percussion instrument? (1 mark)
   A. Recorder
   B. Drum
   C. Trumpet
   D. Whistle

2. On a xylophone, the short bars give (1 mark)
   A. low notes
   B. high notes
   C. no sound
   D. the loudest sound only

3. How can you make the brightest part of a charcoal drawing? (1 mark)
   A. Leave the paper white or lift charcoal with a clean eraser
   B. Colour it black
   C. Smudge with a wet cloth
   D. Press very hard

4. The kayamba is a shaker used mainly at the (1 mark)
   A. North of Lake Victoria only
   B. Kenyan highlands only
   C. Northern desert only
   D. Kenyan coast

5. What do the letters WA stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Water Aim
   B. Wing Attack
   C. Wing Ally
   D. Winning Arm

6. What does giving with the ball mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kicking the ball
   B. Throwing the ball away
   C. Bending the arms as the ball arrives to soften the catch
   D. Handing the ball to the umpire

7. How should a good netball player treat the other team at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Tease them
   B. Shout at them
   C. Shake hands and thank them
   D. Ignore them

8. What do the letters GK stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Goal Kicker
   B. Goal Keeper
   C. Great Kicker
   D. Goal King

9. Yellow mixed with blue makes (1 mark)
   A. pink
   B. purple
   C. orange
   D. green

10. After painting, how should you store a brush? (1 mark)
   A. Standing on its hairs in water
   B. Under a heavy book
   C. Covered in paint
   D. Washed and laid flat or with hairs upwards

11. When darkening a colour with black, you should add (1 mark)
   A. a little at a time
   B. nothing
   C. a whole tin at once
   D. white first

12. Blue mixed with red makes (1 mark)
   A. orange
   B. green
   C. purple
   D. yellow

13. How long does a quaver rest last? (1 mark)
   A. Four beats
   B. One beat
   C. Two beats
   D. Half a beat

14. What is a critique? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of drum
   B. A rest
   C. A rude remark
   D. An honest, kind talk about someone's work

15. Which letter has an ascender? (1 mark)
   A. a
   B. o
   C. e
   D. b

16. Rhythm is (1 mark)
   A. how high a note is
   B. the loudness of the singer
   C. the name of the song
   D. the pattern of long and short sounds

17. In the worked melody of this lesson, the last note is (1 mark)
   A. a pair of quavers
   B. r, a rest
   C. m, a quaver
   D. d, a crotchet

18. What is clay? (1 mark)
   A. A metal
   B. A type of paper
   C. A kind of wood
   D. Fine sticky soil that is soft when wet and hard when dry

19. A melody is (1 mark)
   A. the words only
   B. the tune of a song
   C. the beat of a drum
   D. the loudness

20. Which tune ends on the home note? (1 mark)
   A. d r m r d
   B. m r m r
   C. r m r m
   D. d r m r

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. State two ways to keep the working area clean after painting. (2 marks)

22. Describe the steps for painting a picture of one object that shows colour value. (5 marks)

23. Explain the job of the drumhead and the shell of a drum. (3 marks)

24. Describe how to make an overhead pass. (3 marks)

25. Describe how to draw a drum with tonal value using the smudge technique. (4 marks)

26. Explain why only the Goal Shooter and Goal Attack can score goals. (3 marks)

27. Give three safety measures to observe when playing netball. (3 marks)

28. Explain how a drum makes sound and how its parts work together. (5 marks)

29. What is stepwise motion? Give an example. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Drum
   A drum is struck to make sound. The others are played by blowing.

2. B — high notes
   Shorter bars vibrate faster and sound higher.

3. A — Leave the paper white or lift charcoal with a clean eraser
   The brightest parts have little or no charcoal.

4. D — Kenyan coast
   The kayamba is a coastal shaker used by the Mijikenda and other coastal people.

5. B — Wing Attack
   WA is the Wing Attack, who feeds the shooters.

6. C — Bending the arms as the ball arrives to soften the catch
   Bending the arms takes the force out of the ball.

7. C — Shake hands and thank them
   Fair play means being respectful whether you win or lose.

8. B — Goal Keeper
   GK is the Goal Keeper, a defender who guards the goal.

9. D — green
   Yellow and blue give green.

10. D — Washed and laid flat or with hairs upwards
   Washing and shaping the tip keeps the brush in good shape.

11. A — a little at a time
   Black is strong, so add it in small amounts.

12. C — purple
   Blue and red give purple.

13. D — Half a beat
   A quaver rest is half a beat of silence.

14. D — An honest, kind talk about someone's work
   A critique gives fair comments in a respectful way.

15. D — b
   The stem of b goes up above the small letters.

16. D — the pattern of long and short sounds
   Rhythm is the pattern of sounds over the beat.

17. D — d, a crotchet
   The final note is d, on a crotchet.

18. D — Fine sticky soil that is soft when wet and hard when dry
   Clay is a fine, sticky soil used for modelling.

19. B — the tune of a song
   A melody is a series of notes that make a tune.

20. A — d r m r d
   Only d r m r d ends on d.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash the brushes and containers, wipe the desk, put the paper in the bin. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: Choose an object and place it near a window. Draw the outline lightly. Mix the main colour and paint the object. Add a lighter tone on the lit side and a darker tone on the shadow side. Blend the edges and add a shadow, then let it dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of five clear steps.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: The drumhead vibrates when struck and makes the sound. The hollow shell makes the sound fuller and louder.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the drumhead, 2 marks for the shell's job explained.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Lift the ball above the head with both hands and elbows slightly bent. Step forward and throw from behind the head, flicking wrists and fingers so the ball goes over the defender.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the start, 1 mark for the throw, 1 mark for going over the defender.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw the outline lightly. Shade the dark parts by pressing harder and the light parts by pressing lightly. Rub the shading with a finger or tissue to blend. Leave the brightest part white.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Netball rules say only these two attackers may shoot, and only from inside the goal circle. Other players help by passing the ball to them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the two players, 1 mark for the goal circle, 1 mark for the role of the others.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove jewellery, cut long nails, warm up, wear proper shoes, play on flat ground. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each measure.

28. (5 marks)
   Answer: The beater or hand strikes the drumhead, which vibrates and makes the sound. The hollow shell makes the sound fuller and louder. The ropes hold the skin tight, and a tighter skin gives a higher sound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for striking, vibrating skin, shell, ropes, and effect of tightness on pitch.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Moving from a note to the next note above or below. For example, d to r.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
